# Phlix

> Phlix is a free iOS photo browser for Plex Media Server. Chronological timeline with year scrubber, big-screen slideshows on your TV, saves to the Photos app, and smooth scrolling through 100,000+ photos.

## Overview

Phlix is a third-party iOS app that connects to your Plex Media Server to browse, view, and save your photo library. It was built to provide the photo experience that Plex users have been missing: a chronological timeline, fast performance with large libraries, and big-screen slideshows on your TV.

- Website: https://phlixapp.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/phlix-photos/id6796820208
- Developer: Jason Loomis
- Platform: iOS 17+ (iPhone and iPad)
- Category: Photo & Video
- Price: Free to download (optional Pro upgrade)

## Key Features

### Chronological Timeline
Photos displayed chronologically with a year scrubber. Tap any year to jump instantly. Navigate decades of memories in seconds.

### Built for Scale
Handles libraries of 100,000+ photos using server-side year filtering, virtual paging, and intelligent prefetching. The first screen appears in seconds; the year index fills in behind it.

### Big-Screen Slideshows on Your TV
With Screen Mirroring on, or over an HDMI adapter, the TV shows just the photo, full screen, while your phone shows the controls. Photos display at the resolution your TV reports to iOS, up to 4K over a USB-C HDMI adapter. A Pro feature; without Pro the TV mirrors your phone.

### Save to Photos
Save photos and clips straight into your iOS Photos app. 25 free saves, unlimited with Pro.

### Cellular Data Saver
Automatic thumbnail compression and paused prefetching on cellular or in Low Data Mode. Full quality on Wi-Fi. On by default, with two switches in Settings (Use Mobile Data, Reduce Data on Cellular) if you want it different.

### Search & Organize
Search photo and video titles, tags and collections. Mark favorites. Switch between multiple photo libraries on the same Plex server.

### Accessibility
Full VoiceOver support with position announcements. Universal iPhone and iPad app with adaptive grid layout and split view.

## Pricing

- **Free**: Full library browsing, timeline, year scrubber, search, favorites, on-device slideshow, 25 saves to Photos
- **Pro Lifetime**: $19.99 one-time purchase. Unlimited saves to Photos, big-screen slideshows on your TV, Family Sharing included
- **Pro Yearly**: $6.99/year. Same Pro features, cancel anytime
- **14-Day Trial**: Try Pro free for 14 days. No subscription, no credit card, no charge

## Comparison with Official Plex Photos App

Phlix offers features the official Plex Photos iOS app does not list:
- Chronological photo timeline with a year scrubber
- Large library performance (100,000+ photos)
- Big-screen slideshows: with Screen Mirroring on, or over HDMI, the TV shows just the photo while your phone shows the controls
- Saves to the iOS Photos app
- Cellular data saver
- Full-bleed photo viewing (no persistent UI chrome)
- Full VoiceOver accessibility
- Frequent developer updates

## Privacy

- No ads, no tracking pixels, no session replay
- Anonymous usage analytics only (opt-out available in Settings)
- No photos, filenames, server addresses, Plex credentials, names or email addresses collected
- No third-party advertising SDKs
- Privacy policy: https://phlixapp.com/privacy

## Requirements

- iOS 17 or later
- A Plex Media Server with at least one photo library
- A Plex account. No Plex Pass is needed on your home network. Away from home, Plex requires the server owner to have a Plex Pass (or you a Remote Watch Pass) to stream personal video — including clips in Phlix — and Plex's photo exemption is stated only for its own Plex Photos app, so photos may be affected too.
